name: get_status
description: Get the current Blockbench state: open project, format, counts of cubes/groups/textures/animations, and edit mode. Call this first to understand the workspace. If you are about to BUILD or TEXTURE a model, call get_guide first. If the user is matching a REFERENCE image (they may have dropped one into the MCP Copilot panel), call get_reference to see it, build, then call compare_reference every pass until match_percent is high — do not judge the match by eye.
